notes.title: Kanji Legends – Update 2.4
notes.content:
[h1][b]1. Ordeals – A New Challenging Mode[/b][/h1]
[b]Put your knowledge to the test in four brand-new, high-difficulty game modes![/b]

[olist]
[*][b]Ordeal of Mystery[/b]

- Characters types are completely [b]random[/b].
- You only choose the number of [b]rounds[/b] and[b] difficulty[/b].
NOTE: Kana and Kanji characters remain separate.

[*][b]Ordeal of Chaos[/b]

- Full unpredictability: random characters, rounds, and difficulty.
- Chaotic visuals and SFX.

[*][b]Ordeal of Madness[/b]

- ¿¿¿

[*][b]Ordeal of Infinity[/b]

- Endless challenge with no fixed round count.
- Beat as many rounds as possible!
[/olist]

[h1][b]2. Trials – New & Improved[/b][/h1]

[olist]
[*][b]NEW - Trial of Flames[/b]

- A fiery new challenge featuring bold visuals.

[*][b] Unified Trials System![/b]

- Kanji and Kana trials are now merged! Use either character set freely!
- Merged Trials:
              Trial of Knowledge ➝ Merged with Trial of Wisdom
              Trial of Haste ➝ Merged with Trial of Agility
              Trial of Sight ➝ Merged with Trial of Perception

[*][b]Trial of Mist[/b]

- Now supports Kana characters.
- Improved visuals.
- New SFX.

[*][b]Trial of Choice[/b]

- Redesigned codebase and visuals.
[/olist]


[h1][b]3. Custom Characters Screen Rework![/b][/h1]

- Kana: Select character rows and columns based on vowels or consonants.
- Kana characters are now properly sorted based on the standard model.
- Improved layout.

[h1][b]4. New Kana & Kanji Menus[/b][/h1]

- Access all Kana and Kanji characters directly from the main menu.
- Kana characters are now properly sorted based on the standard model.
- New feature: Mark characters as “Learned” for tracking progress ( Progress mechanic will be expanded in the next updates).
- Improved layout.

[h1][b]5. Series 4 Kanji Cards[/b][/h1]

A brand-new set of collectible cards!
- Exclusive drops from Ordeal modes.
NOTE: Ordeal of Infinity and does not grant card drops.(It will feature a different type of collectible in the future!)

[h1][b]6. Major UI Rework[/b][/h1]

- New menu animations and graphics.
- Removed outdated UI elements.
- Simplified navigation and layout.
- Stats UI updated to support the new Trials and Ordeals.
- Stats UI now includes a Total Clears counter.


[h1][b]7. New locations[/b][/h1]

- Added locations for the new game modes.
- Removed deprecated and unused areas.
- Improved lighting and overall visual fidelity.

[h1][b]8. Miscellaneous[/b][/h1]

- New effects and visual upgrades throughout the game.
- Completely removed menu navigation animations.
- Codebase improvements for better performance and scalability.

[h1][b]9. Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]

-Fixed an issue where the Insta-Win power-up HUD would persist after use.

notes.title: Kanji Legends Update 2.3
notes.content:
[h1]1. Clear Points (CP) & New Trial Rank System [/h1]

    New Points System: "[b]CP - Clear Points[/b]" has been introduced.
  - Earn [b]CP[/b] by completing trials — the higher the difficulty and set count, the more points you earn.
  - Simplified Stats Menu
  - All ranks for a single trial have been merged into one.
  - Gaining [b]CP[/b] will increase your trials [b]rank[/b].

[h1]2. Variation Points (VP) [/h1]
   New Currency: "[b]VP[/b] - [b]Variation Points[/b]" has been introduced.
  - Rewarded for completing and Trial with[b] at least two[/b] or more Characters tiers or types selected.
  - Trial of Choice requires [b]at least three[/b] tiers or types selected.
  - Spend your earned VP in the shop.

[h1]3. New Kanji Cards Store[/h1]
   - Spend VP to get [b]card packs[/b] from the store.
   - Each pack contains [b]3 random cards[/b] from each series.
   - Available Packs: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Ruby, and Diamond.

[h1]4. Practice Mode New Feature[/h1]
   - A new [b]support[/b] feature is now available for a better learning experience. 
   - All trials can now be practiced using a new '[b]Hint[/b]' system.

[h1]5. Skip Travel Animations[/h1]
   - Toggle this feature on/off from the [b]main menu[/b] settings.

[h1]6. Series 3 Cards Now Available[/h1]
   - Exclusive Drops: Only available from [b]Medium or higher[/b] difficulty trials.
   - You can also find them in the [b]Card Pack shop[/b].

[h1]7. Power-Ups System Rework[/h1]
   - Simplified and improved functionality.
   - Improved shop layout and adjusted prices.
   - Simplified the UI.
   - Changed the icons.

[h1]8. Kanji & Kana Boards Improvements[/h1]
   - UI rework.
   - Optimized performance.

[h1]9. Other UI Improvements[/h1]
   - Card Collection UI: Upgraded with animations.
   - Trials UI: Overhauled for better clarity and simplicity.
   - Added a range of new UI animations.
   
[h1]10. Technical Improvements[/h1]
   - Codebase updates.
   - Overall performance optimizations.
   - Improved ambient lighting.
   - Various bug fixes.

notes.title: Kanji Legends: Update 2.1 – New Content & Features
notes.content:
[h1][b]Collectible Cards:[/b][/h1]
- Earn and collect unique [b]cards[/b] as you progress through trials.
- [b]Series 1[/b] launches with this update!
- Higher difficulty trials yield [b]rarer[/b] and more valuable cards.
- Each card features a distinct [b]rarity level[/b], adding excitement and challenge to every trial.
- Certain cards contain hints for future content and [b]hidden secrets[/b]! — stay tuned for more surprises!

- New Location: [b]The Collectibles House[/b] — explore your growing collection.
- Enhanced UI Elements: Improved interface for a smoother experience.
- Gameplay Reworks: Adjustments to enhance overall balance and enjoyment.
- Minor Bug Fixes: Various stability and performance improvements.
- Updated [b]Kana[/b] and[b] Kanji[/b] lists for a more streamlined and efficient learning experience.
- Expanded the starting area to accommodate more future content and features.
- Enhanced visuals and effects for a more immersive and dynamic experience.


[b]Start your journey to collect them all and explore the new features![/b]

 - Additional Bug Fixes: Various other bugs were identified and resolved to improve overall stability and performance.

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]Kanji Legends Update 2.0 is Now Live![/b][/h1]
[h3][b]What's New:[/b][/h3]

   - Expanded Kanji List: We've added 1,130 new Kanji characters to help you master even more of the language.
   - Enhanced Player Stats: Keep better track of your progress with an improved stats menu.
   - Simplified Navigation: Enjoy a more intuitive and streamlined menu navigation system.
   - Upgraded UI & Art: Aesthetic improvements for a more visually appealing experience.
   - Feature Relocation: We've reorganized some features for smoother gameplay and a better overall user experience.
   - Practice Mode Enhancements: Practice mode has been fine-tuned for better learning efficiency.
   - Improved Kana and Kanji Charts: New and improved charts for quicker reference and learning.
   - Codebase Improvements: Behind-the-scenes optimizations for smoother performance.
   - Bug Fixes & Improvements: Minor bugs squashed and improvements made across the board.
